records.name: Rose Pedals to Success
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that helps young people learn business skills, build leadership, and work toward money independence through cohort sessions and mentoring.
records.what_you_do: Young people sign up for cohort sessions, get mentoring, and get hands-on business practice. Families can also come to the group's Community Day family event.

schedule.text: Community Day on August 23, 2026, 12 pm to 4 pm, with youth activities and shopping. Cohort sessions are listed as free, but the page does not show their dates.

cost.text: Cohort sessions are listed as free. Costs for other events are not stated.

first_step.how: Use the Sign Youth Up link on rosepedalstosuccess.org, or email info@rosepedalstosuccess.org to ask about the next cohort.
first_step.basis: A sign-up link and an email address are published and the program is open to youth in Philadelphia. The page does not say how places are chosen.

records.notes: The IRS-derived address (1318 W Clearfield St) differs from the address on the group's own site (2536 N Broad St), which is the one recorded. The site shows no legal name and does not state the ages served. Social accounts were not recorded. The Community Day date is printed on the page.

records.name: Vacetime Foundation

records.what_you_do: The site has a volunteer page behind its Help Us button, but it does not describe tasks or schedules. Donations are taken online.

cost.text: No costs are listed for programs or volunteering. Donations are accepted.

first_step.how: Use the Help Us button on vacetimefoundation.org to ask how to volunteer.
first_step.basis: A volunteer page exists, but the way in is unclear because the site gives no details on tasks or sign-up.

records.notes: No dated news or events were found. The only year on the site is a footer copyright of 2024, which is not evidence. Cautions for the owner: the privacy notice names the group differently ('Cacetime Foundation'), and several links look like template placeholders. No email, phone, or street address is published, so the IRS-derived address (2534 N Broad St) is not recorded as a location. Verify before any money or personal data is given.

records.name: We DREAM
records.summary: A youth development nonprofit for young people and adolescents. It runs a summer camp, a youth program called TGIF, and a boys' program called Boys Dream, with the goal of helping young people build confidence and pursue their goals.
records.what_you_do: Young people take part in the summer camp and the group's other youth programs. The site does not say what each program involves.

cost.text: Costs are not stated on the site.

first_step.how: Follow the group on Instagram, or use the Connect page on wedreamdoyou.com to ask about the summer camp.
first_step.basis: The site has no sign-up steps, dates or costs, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The homepage has no dated events or news. The Board of Directors and Boys Dream links point to pages whose addresses suggest copies of other pages, so some pages may be placeholders. The legal name is the IRS name, We Do Realize Every Adolescent Matters, and the everyday name is used here. Ages and enrollment steps for the camp are not shown on the homepage.

records.name: Bless Philadelphia
records.summary: Community leaders and neighbors in Philadelphia who want to reduce violence, teach money skills and job readiness, support health and well-being, and make streets and playgrounds feel safe. Many of these goals are written as plans, not as running programs.
records.what_you_do: Neighbors who need help or want to help someone else can reach out through the contact page. The site does not describe volunteer tasks or sign-up steps.

cost.text: No costs are stated. The site says donations are tax deductible.

first_step.how: Send a message through the contact page on blessphiladelphia.com to ask how to volunteer or get help.
first_step.basis: The site invites people to reach out and links a volunteer page, but gives no sign-up steps or dates.

records.notes: The homepage has no dated events or news. The linked programs, events, news and volunteer pages were not read, so their content is not recorded. The site lists EIN 88-1151326, which matches the IRS-derived record.

records.name: Energy Justice Network
records.summary: An advocacy group that opposes polluting energy and waste facilities and promotes zero waste, wind, solar, and energy storage. It maps facilities nationwide and helps local residents organize against threats in their own communities.
records.what_you_do: Sign up on the site to get news and invitations to activism meetings, and get help with a local environmental threat. The site links to a Get Involved page and a Donate page.

cost.text: No cost is stated to join, volunteer, or attend. Donations are invited.

first_step.how: Fill in the environmental justice activism sign-up form on energyjustice.net to get on the list for local activism news.
first_step.basis: The sign-up form and the Get Involved page are public, but meeting times and places are not listed on the homepage.

records.notes: The newest dated item on the homepage is a news post dated April 22, 2026, with other posts dated January 2026, December 2025 and September 2025. The group works nationally from a Philadelphia office and focuses on environmental justice. The Member Services page was linked but not read. The IRS-derived name and address match the site.

records.name: Global United FC Foundation
records.summary: A nonprofit that offers free youth soccer training for children ages 5 to 15, along with mentoring, education, health programs, and community events such as multicultural fairs and tournaments.
records.what_you_do: Children take part in free soccer training and mentoring. Families can attend community events. The listing invites donations, volunteers and partners.

cost.text: Programs are listed as free of charge.

first_step.how: Ask the group how to sign a child up for the free soccer training. The public listing does not show a sign-up route.
first_step.basis: Free and open to children ages 5 to 15, but no sign-up steps or schedule are published, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Matched by EIN 992242580, which appears in the Benevity profile address and matches the IRS-derived record. The group's own site (globalunited215.com) returned HTTP 404 at both the bare and www addresses, so it is not recorded as a working site. The Benevity page shows only a 2026 copyright footer, which is not evidence, so status is unknown. This is not the international Global United FC network (globalunitedfc.com) or its Johannesburg arm, which are different organizations. The sign-up route is unconfirmed.

records.name: G.A.R. Civil War Museum & Library
records.summary: A volunteer-run Civil War museum and research library in Holmesburg. Visitors can tour the exhibits, and members and donors can request research help with Civil War veterans and Grand Army of the Republic posts. It does not do family genealogy.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers keep the museum and library open. Visitors can come on a Tuesday or book a guided visit, and members and donors can request research. The site does not describe a volunteer sign-up process.

schedule.text: Open Tuesdays 11 am to 4 pm, or by appointment. Email to book a guided visit, which needs seven days notice. Children under 14 must come with an adult.

cost.text: No admission fee. Membership or a donation is suggested, with no amounts given.

first_step.how: Come on a Tuesday between 11 am and 4 pm, or email garmuslib1866@gmail.com to book a guided visit.
first_step.basis: Open to the public with no admission fee and a clear way to visit, but the volunteer process is not described.

records.notes: The IRS-derived legal name is Grand Army of the Republic Civil War Museum. The site's newsletter list includes issues labeled Summer 2026 and Spring 2026, which give only a season, so the newest issue with a month (October 2025) is used for last_sign_of_life. The newsletter PDFs were not opened. The homepage says the museum is staffed entirely by volunteers.

first_step.basis: Services start with an application, and the site does not say what the application involves.
